title: Add the 150 people the naming claims are about
description: The people table has held 60 rows since it was built: the players of world championship games, because that is what the builder derives it from. The named-after-person conversion asserts that 200 catalogue names carry a person's name, and a claim whose subject is not in the table is a dangling reference. These are exactly the people those claims name — no more, so the table stays a record of people this catalogue says something about rather than a directory. Identities come from docs/evidence/people/wikidata-resolved.tsv, where 243 person_ids were resolved against Wikidata on 2026-07-31 and every surname collision was recorded. Only high-confidence identities carry a QID: the ten with none, and the one medium-confidence candidate, keep an empty column and a note saying so, because a wrong identifier silently attaches an opening to the wrong human and a missing one asks a visible question. Chess.com, Frankenstein's monster and Count Dracula are not here, and neither are their claims.
